title: Corpses of Yazidis murdered by ISIS remain in Baghdad freezers
gist: Podcast description: Yazidi lawmaker Murad Ismael urges Iraq's central government and the Kurdistan Regional Government to pay reparations for failing to protect Yazidis from ISIS's 2014 massacres, as hundreds of victims' remains still await DNA identification in Baghdad.

insights.claim: Yazidi lawmaker Murad Ismael is calling on Iraq's central government and the Kurdistan Regional Government to pay reparations to Yazidis for failing to protect them from the 2014 ISIS massacres.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Reparations claims could become a fiscal and political liability for Baghdad and Erbil.

insights.claim: More than 10 years on, hundreds of remains of Yazidi victims killed by ISIS are held at Baghdad's Forensic Medicine Department awaiting DNA identification.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Slow transitional justice signals weak state capacity in Iraq.
insights.quote: hundreds of remains of Yazidi victims killed by ISIS are being held at the Forensic Medicine Department in Baghdad

insights.claim: The US considers the 2014 ISIS massacres of Yazidis a genocide.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Genocide designation underpins legal claims for reparations.
